caption:
Google changed how it ranks local businesses.

Review count still matters. 2026 local SEO audits point to a bigger factor: profile activity. Call clicks, photo views, and how recently you posted now carry real weight.

A profile that stops posting starts dropping. Industry audits tracking Google Business Profiles found visibility drops once photos or posts stop for 30+ days, even with strong reviews still sitting there.

Do this by Friday:

1. Post one update with a photo from a finished job
2. Reply to every open review, good or bad
3. Check your last post date. Past 30 days, that's your leak

Black Arrow's platform writes a week of on-brand posts from one goal and turns every closed job into a review request.

Try it on your own profile for 14 days, no card required.

DM TRIAL

rationale: Interprets a genuinely fresh 2026 GBP ranking pattern, profile-activity weight plus posting-decay, distinct from every prior GBP angle shipped, in the reel format that still wins reach for cold-audience news.
